description: A researcher-developed Arabic curriculum-based measurement toolkit for assessing letter naming, letter sounds, phoneme segmentation, and word-reading fluency in Saudi kindergarten and grade 1 students.

description: An Arabic-language battery of validated self-report scales developed for measuring study processes, grit, and academic engagement among university physical-education and sport students.
title: Arabic-language PE-SPQ, PE-Grit and A-USEI instrument battery

description: Validated Modern Standard Arabic self-report instruments used to assess university students’ sleep quality and physical activity, respectively.
title: Arabic Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) and Arabic IPAQ Short Form

description: A bilingual-translated and Saudi-context-adapted questionnaire battery measuring autonomy, competence, relatedness, and motivational regulation among students learning physical education online.
title: Arabic versions of the PE-ARCS and PE-MS questionnaires

description: ARC Core is a K–12 English and Spanish literacy curriculum developed by American Reading Company that organizes extensive reading, writing, research, and analysis into knowledge-building units integrating literacy with science, social studies, and literature.
title: ARC Core

description: A healthcare evidence-based-practice implementation framework that uses organizational readiness, trained mentors, and supportive strategies to build clinicians’ EBP competence and sustain practice change.
title: ARCC model (Advancing Research and Clinical Practice through Close Collaboration)

description: A 16-week classroom programme developed by the ARDESOS-DIAPROVE team that teaches critical thinking through problem-based and cooperative learning activities, contextualized problems, rubrics, and feedback.
title: ARDESOS-DIAPROVE program

description: A structured science-laboratory instructional framework that organizes group inquiry, argument construction, interactive argumentation, individual scientific writing, and peer review.
title: Argument-Driven Inquiry (ADI) laboratory instruction model

description: Argus is a static-analysis triage tool developed by David Racovan et al.
title: Argus

description: ARIN-561 is an educational game developed by Leitner et al.
title: ARIN-561

description: A study-created database linking longitudinal K–12 education records from the Arizona Department of Education with child records from the Arizona Department of Child Safety to identify and describe students in foster care.
title: Arizona linked education–child welfare student database

title: Arloon's The Human Body Anatomy

description: A Success for All Foundation preschool and kindergarten curriculum programme that combines language and early-reading lessons with child-facing computer activities, videos, Home Links, and video-based teacher professional development.
title: Around the Corner (ATC)

description: ARPG+ is a real-time AI coaching system developed by Ye et al.
title: ARPG+ dual-process real-time coaching system

description: Artemisa is a chatbot developed through the ACACIA project to provide anonymous, accessible support for university students experiencing sexual harassment and to recruit volunteers promoting diversity and tolerance.
title: Artemisa

description: ArthroSim is a high-fidelity virtual-reality knee arthroscopy simulator with finite-element anatomical modeling and dual-device haptic feedback, made by TolTech Touch of Life Technologies.
title: ArthroSim

description: Arthur is a PBS Kids educational television programme based on Marc Brown’s storybooks, produced and distributed for young children through PBS stations and online materials.
title: Arthur book-based educational television program

description: ARTS is an adaptive learning system developed by Everett Mettler and colleagues that sequences practice items using learner accuracy and response time to regulate spacing, priority, interleaving, and retirement.
title: ARTS: Adaptive Response Time Based Sequencing
